events.text: Harrow Bakery closed: it could no longer pay its workers.
Rhys Crane died of old age at age 71, leaving behind Ilsa Hollow.
Carys Larkin was born to Nessa Pickering and Ronan Larkin.
Nial Moss came of age and went looking for work.
Hester Juniper and Lorne Tanner fell in love and became partners.
Hester Juniper and Lorne Tanner set up the Tanner household.
Anselm Juniper founded Juniper Bakery, investing 2,462 marks.
Linnet Moss founded Moss Builders, investing 3,058 marks.
Juniper Bakery closed: it could no longer pay its workers.
Ivo Heath founded Heath Bakery, investing 2,419 marks.
Moss Builders closed: it could no longer pay its workers.
Merrick Heath came of age and went looking for work.
Ulric Brook died of illness at age 58.
The Brook household came to an end.
Jarvis Upton was born to Elowen Sedge and Fitz Upton.
